scope: Unbiasedness of a prespecified convex blend a*Zhat_p+(1-a)*Zhat_q when the completed pilot estimate Zhat_p is unbiased for Z, the pilot sigma-field may select a fresh production configuration, and the fresh production estimator satisfies E[Zhat_q | pilot]=Z for every configuration that can be selected. Under exactly these conditions the blend is unbiased and Cov(Zhat_p-Z, Zhat_q-Z)=0. No claim is made for pilot-dependent blend weights, production estimators whose conditional mean depends on pilot output, reuse of randomness that breaks the conditional-mean condition, variance/MSE dominance, generic adaptive SMC, or real-agent performance.

assumptions: E[Zhat_p]=Z and Zhat_p is P-measurable after the completed pilot.
The selected production configuration is P-measurable.
Fresh production randomness is such that E[Zhat_q | P]=Z for every selectable configuration.
The blend coefficient a is prespecified independently of the realised pilot, with 0<=a<=1.
checks: Linearity gives E[a Zhat_p+(1-a) Zhat_q]=a Z+(1-a) Z=Z.
Because Zhat_p-Z is P-measurable, E[(Zhat_p-Z)(Zhat_q-Z)]=E[(Zhat_p-Z)E[Zhat_q-Z|P]]=0, establishing the stated zero covariance.
If a is pilot-dependent, E[a(P)(Zhat_p-Z)] need not vanish, so the worker's fixed-weight scope guard is necessary.

grading.uncertainty: The unbiasedness and zero-covariance conclusions follow directly from the stated conditional-mean assumptions and a prespecified blend coefficient. Evidence strength therefore concerns whether those assumptions hold in any concrete production design; this grade does not establish that an arbitrary adaptive or randomness-reusing production estimator satisfies E[Zhat_q|pilot]=Z, nor does it establish variance improvement.

phase1_acceptance_boundary: This candidate is supporting evidence for a narrow estimator-combination guard only. It does not by itself close any end-to-end Work-dependency-elimination row or the Phase-1 root; concrete routes still require all zero-execution, zero-quota, zero-cost, usefulness, conflict, authority and persistence gates.
